questions.questionText:
Spot the error in the given sentence and select the correct sentence from the options
given.
When it was time to chose between staying or leaving the country, she choose to stay
back.
options:
When it was time to choose between staying or leaving the country, she chose to
stay back.

When it was time to chose between staying or leaving the country, she chose to stay
back.

When it was time to choice between staying or leaving the country, she choose to
stay back.

When it was time to have chose between staying or leaving the country, she chose to
stay back.
questions.explanation: The official answer key provided by Staff Selection Commission is Option (A).

questions.questionText:
Three Statements are given followed by Three conclusions numbered I, II and III.
Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with
commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the
statements.

All reds are roses.
No violet is a red.
Some tulips are violets.

I. Some roses are violets.
II. No tulip is a red.
III. No rose is a tulip.
options: Both conclusions I and III follow.
Both conclusions I and II follow.
